name: Brian Siddhartha Ingle
reason: An osteopath and naturopath whose work is mainly treatment: all four of his Shift courses and his own Living Somatics trainings, somatic yoga and membership are sold on pain, back pain, anxiety, trauma, eyesight, immunity, thyroid or 'reversing' chronic conditions, his only book (Stillness Speaks) is a course bonus with no Amazon listing, and what would remain is a handful of 13 to 17-year-old movement clips from his small YouTube channel (490 subscribers), so almost nothing passes the health-claim rule.
